content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fails fallback on both elements).**

- **Affiliates:** the grant in Article II (p0030) runs to Licensee only; Article II restrictions bar access by "any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee" (p0045) and by third parties absent Licensor consent (p0041). No notice-based path for Affiliates exists, and "Licensee" is not defined to include Affiliates.
- **Successor transfer:** p0149 bars any assignment or transfer of licence rights without Licensor's consent and defers change-of-control to Article XX, where any merger, asset sale or control change *automatically terminates* the Agreement and all licences unless Licensor consents in advance — with broad deemed-reasonable grounds for refusal (p0134).

**Cure (fallback level, three surgical edits, minimality gate ok:true):** Affiliates added to the grant on written notice; the employee-access restriction conformed so Affiliate personnel are not prohibited; and a successor-transfer carve-out inserted into the change-of-control auto-termination trigger, stated directly as permitted "without Licensor's approval" so no broad override or dangling consent mechanic results. Preferred-level items (perpetual/irrevocable, contractors, breach-only termination) were not pursued.
